project_title: CR-475 Item Consumption Report Enhancements - MyGenie POS
target_audience: Restaurant owners and managers analyzing item-level consumption and ingredient wastage on desktop

grids.kpi_strip: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6
grids.filter_bar: flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-end bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-4 mb-5 shadow-sm
grids.addon_card_layout: bg-slate-50/70 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 mt-4 space-y-4

layouts.main_content: flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden px-6 py-6
layouts.table_container: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden shadow-sm
layouts.expanded_row_container: px-4 pb-5 pt-2 bg-orange-50/20 border-b border-slate-100
layouts.addon_container: mt-4 ml-6 sm:ml-10 p-4 bg-slate-100/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80

visual_enhancers.tinted_greys: Use slate-50 (#f8fafc) and slate-100 (#f1f5f9) instead of pure white/grey
visual_enhancers.menu_badge: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-semibold bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200 mt-0.5
visual_enhancers.addon_badge: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 border border-orange-200 uppercase tracking-wide
visual_enhancers.kpi_accent_borders: 3px left border on KPI cards: Orange (#F26B33), Blue (#3B82F6), Red (#EF4444), Amber (#F59E0B), Green (#329937), Dark Red (#DC2626)
visual_enhancers.add_ons_section_banner: flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-slate-200 mb-3

accessibility.contrast: All text elements satisfy WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 ratio

key_functionalities_cr475.details: Menu filter dropdown in filter bar with options 'All Menus', 'Normal', 'Premium', 'Party'. Filtering items by matching item.food_for or menu_name. Each row displays a small grey badge below item name showing its menu.

key_functionalities_cr475.feature: 6th KPI Card - Total Returned to Inv.
key_functionalities_cr475.details: KPI strip now features 6 cards in a 2x3 grid: Total Items, Total Punched, Total Cancelled in Row 1; Total Returned to Inv., Total Inv. Consumed, Revenue Loss in Row 2. 'Total Returned to Inv.' card has an Amber/Blue border highlight.

key_functionalities_cr475.feature: Add-ons Drill-down Section in Expandable Row
key_functionalities_cr475.details: For items with recipe add-ons, a 4th section 'Add-ons (N)' appears below dish ingredient sub-tables with note 'Add-on ingredients already included in dish totals above'. Each add-on features an orange badge, quantity breakdown row (Sold, Cancelled, Returned, Wastage, Consumed), and its own 3 ingredient sub-tables (Consumed/Returned/Wastage).

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Menu' filter dropdown (Select component) in the filter bar alongside search input, populated with All Menus, Normal, Premium, Party.
Add 'food_for' menu badge under item name in each row of the Item Consumption Report table.
Update KPI strip grid to a 2-row x 3-column layout (6 KPI cards total) including the new 6th card 'Total Returned to Inv.'
In the expanded row view, below dish ingredient sub-tables, render the Add-ons section if the dish has add-ons.
Show the callout banner: 'Add-on ingredients already included in dish totals above'.
For each add-on item, display: Add-on Name + 'Add-on' Tag + Quantity summary strip (Sold, Cancelled, Returned, Wastage, Consumed) + 3 ingredient sub-tables (Consumed, Returned, Wastage).

Ensure all key elements include `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `item-consumption-menu-filter`, `item-consumption-kpi-total-returned`, `item-consumption-row-menu-badge-{id}`, `item-consumption-addon-card-{id}`).

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.testing_attributes: All interactive buttons, inputs, dropdowns, table rows, and KPI values MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.no_center_everything: Keep left-aligned text for titles, item names, and search inputs. Right-align numeric values.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.contrast_guarantee: Never use light grey text on light grey backgrounds. Minimum text contrast is 4.5:1.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.no_transparent_overlays: Ensure dropdowns, headers, and modal overlays use explicit non-transparent backgrounds with backdrop blur.
